priorityList: Cast Stormkeeper ~3 seconds before the pull.
Cast Lava Burst ~1.5 second before the pull so it lands right after the pull.
Cast Ascendance with on-use trinkets and potions.
Cast Tempest.
Cast Lava Burst.
Proceed with regular rotation.
Cast Stormkeeper 1-2 GCDs before Ascendance.
Cast Ascendance, sync with on-use trinkets, Bloodlust, and Tempered Potion.
Cast Earth Shock if Ascendance will fade within the next 3 seconds.
Refresh Voltaic Blaze or Flame Shock if Ascendance will fade within the next 3 seconds.
Cast Voltaic Blaze or Flame Shock when it has 6 seconds or less remaining to optimize movement.
Cast Tempest, preferably with the Master of the Elements buff active.
Cast Earth Shock whenever you are less than 15 Maelstrom from capping or when Master of the Elements is active.
Cast Lava Burst if Flame Shock is up (if using Master of the Elements, only cast if the buff is not currently active).
Cast Lightning Bolt.
Spend Master of the Elements on Tempest
Sync Ascendance with pooled resources including Maelstrom and Tempest procs
Cast Elemental Blast or Earth Shock to avoid wasting Maelstrom
Cast Lava Burst to trigger Lava Surge procs for Master of the Elements
Utilize Nature's Swiftness and Spiritwalker's Grace to maintain casting uptime during movement
